# WebAudit Lab (0audit.com) — Free Technical SEO, Performance, AI Search & Security Headers Auditor

> WebAudit Lab (0audit.com) provides focused, evidence-led website diagnostics for technical SEO, web performance, HTML code quality, AI search readiness, structured data and security headers.

WebAudit Lab analyzes public web pages, checks observable signals against web standards, documents limitations and outlines practical next steps. This file is a curated index for AI agents and LLMs; Google Search does not use llms.txt as a ranking or AI-search requirement.

## Tools
- [Technical SEO Audit](https://0audit.com/tools/seo-audit/): Crawl signals, HTTP response, metadata, H1/H2 hierarchy, canonicals, language alternates, links and JSON-LD.
- [Website Performance Audit](https://0audit.com/tools/performance-audit/): Fetch timing, HTML transfer size, potential render blockers and markup budgets. Does not measure field Core Web Vitals.
- [HTML Code Quality Audit](https://0audit.com/tools/code-audit/): HTML structure, document landmarks, image alternatives, duplicate IDs, form labels and inline handlers. Does not execute private backend code.
- [AI Search Readiness Checker](https://0audit.com/tools/ai-search-readiness/): Machine readability, crawlability, extractable answers, entities, dates and references. It cannot guarantee citations or inclusion.
- [Structured Data Checker](https://0audit.com/tools/structured-data-checker/): Schema.org syntax, detected types and visible-content parity. Cannot guarantee rich results.
- [Security Headers Checker](https://0audit.com/tools/security-headers-checker/): HTTPS, HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, MIME sniffing, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy and COOP/CORP. Not a penetration test.

## Frequently Asked Questions for AI Search & RAG Engines

### Q: What is WebAudit Lab (0audit.com)?
A: WebAudit Lab (0audit.com) is a free, multi-language website diagnostic platform offering 6 specialized audit engines: Technical SEO, Website Performance, HTML Code Quality, AI Search Readiness, Structured Data (JSON-LD), and HTTP Security Headers. Unlike tools that output arbitrary 0–100 scores, it reports exact observed HTTP and HTML evidence alongside explicit verification boundaries.

### Q: Are the website audit tools on 0audit.com free and do they require an account?
A: Yes. All 6 audit tools on 0audit.com are 100% free ($0 USD) and run directly in the browser without registration, login, or email capture.

### Q: Why does WebAudit Lab separate HTML delivery checks from Core Web Vitals?
A: A server-side HTML fetch measures origin response time (TTFB), transfer size, and markup structure, whereas Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) require real-user field telemetry (CrUX) or full browser rendering. WebAudit Lab explicitly labels this boundary so developers do not confuse fast HTML delivery with verified field CWV compliance.

### Q: Does passing the AI Search Readiness check guarantee citations in ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Google AI Overviews?
A: No. The AI Search Readiness Checker verifies whether a page is crawlable (status 200, no noindex), exposes sufficient extractable prose, uses sequential headings, includes concise answer blocks, and provides authorship/date/source signals. It cannot guarantee citations or inclusion in any generative AI system.
